rule: A journey needs at least one credible external reference OR an explicit GAS-establishes-benchmark finding. References are not a whitelist.

journeys.name: New User to First Meaningful Action
Configure Risk
journeys.gasPosition: GAS must make CRUISE/BOOST/REDLINE understandable without documentation or color alone

journeys.name: Social Result to Same Game
bestLaws: social object adjacent to economic action
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes benchmark: RESULT -> CONFIG -> TRY -> EXPLICIT IGNITION; no reference cleanly solves social-to-game replay

journeys.name: Join Crew
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes benchmark for game-native Crew joining/ranking/reversibility

journeys.name: Sell/Withdraw
journeys.gasPosition: meet_or_beat; no intentional exit friction asymmetry

journeys.name: Understand Rebase
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes superior benchmark by adding personal before/after balance impact + reserve context

journeys.name: Understand Reserve
journeys.gasPosition: meet transparency depth while preserving GAS-specific external-only backing semantics

journeys.name: Refresh Mid-Round
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes benchmark; canonical round/wager state must restore exactly and prevent double-submit. No credible public competitor benchmark is needed to weaken this requirement.

journeys.name: Connectivity Failure
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes explicit financial-state recovery benchmark because public competitor error paths are inconsistently observable

journeys.name: Permission Expiry
bestLaws: subsequent friction reduction within granted scope
journeys.gasPosition: meet_or_beat with plain-language scope and deliberate reauthorization

journeys.name: Portfolio / Unified Balance
bestLaws: current value not confused with executable payout
journeys.gasPosition: GAS must additionally distinguish spendable USDC/GAS, locked game amount, marked Bracket positions, reserve and game bankroll

journeys.name: Search / Discovery
journeys.gasPosition: one GAS search primitive should expand from people/Crews/games to future markets

journeys.name: Notification to Action
bestLaws: push notification tied to real-time activity

journeys.name: Future Bracket Event to Position
journeys.gasPosition: Bracket should preserve simple event/outcome comprehension while keeping advanced CLOB depth optional

referenceAdmissionRule: Any product may replace a current reference-best if evidence shows it solves the relevant journey better. Brand popularity alone is not sufficient.
phaseGate: PASS when all J01-J18 are covered by credible reference evidence or explicit GAS-establishes-benchmark findings.
